# CommandPalette

A command palette: a search field with a list of pages and actions to jump to or run, usually opened with
`Mod+K` (register it with useHotkeys). Matching is fuzzy and every word of the query must match; results of the
same group stay together; an optional `onSearch` adds results from a server.

**Interaction**: when it opens, focus is in the search field. `↑` / `↓` move the current result (also on
hover), `Enter` runs it and `Esc` closes the palette; focus then returns to the element that was focused
before. Keys pressed while an input method is composing text are left to the input method. Beyond `limit`
results, a line below the list says how many more there are. The key hints at the bottom use Kbd; the keys of
the palette are registered with useHotkeys in the `commandPalette` scope, so shortcut help can list them.

**Category**: Patterns · **Common uses**: Global search and jump (`Mod+K`), running actions by name, finding people and files

## Import

```ts
import { CommandPalette } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Open it with the button or `Mod+K` (registered with useHotkeys), type to filter, `↑` / `↓` and `Enter` to run.
Matching is fuzzy: "nwp" finds "New project". HotkeysProvider keeps the `Mod+K` of this example from clashing
with the one of the page that shows it.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <HotkeysProvider>
      <Palette />
    </HotkeysProvider>
  )
}
```

## States

### Many results

At most `limit` results (50 by default) are shown; a line below the list says how many more there are.

```tsx
export function ManyResults() {
  return (
    <HotkeysProvider>
      <ManyPalette />
    </HotkeysProvider>
  )
}
```

## Advanced

### Searching a server

`onSearch` adds results from a server after the local matches. It is called when typing stops, and the
signal is aborted when the query changes; "Searching" appears only when the search takes a while.

```tsx
export function AsyncSearch() {
  return (
    <HotkeysProvider>
      <AsyncPalette />
    </HotkeysProvider>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether the palette is open. | — | Yes |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | Called when the palette asks to open or close (`Esc`, clicking outside, running an item). | — | Yes |
| `items` | `readonly CommandPaletteItem[]` | The items, matched locally while typing (see matchCommands). | — | Yes |
| `onSearch` | `(query: string, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<readonly CommandPaletteItem[]>` | Searches more items for a query, such as people or files on a server. Called 150 ms after typing stops; the signal is aborted when the query changes or the palette closes. The results are shown after the local matches, as they are (not matched again). | — | No |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Placeholder of the search field, "Search or run a command" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `emptyText` | `string` | Text shown when nothing matches, "No results" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name of the dialog and the search field, "Command palette" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `limit` | `number` | Largest number of results shown; beyond it, a line below the list says how many more there are. | `50` | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
